unchanged: Scientific target, conditional Gaussian/Student-t law, source bank rows, calibration/data/cutoffs and model arms.
All selected diagnostic thresholds, fixed masks, random streams and bounded attempt budgets.
Raw constant indicators and nonstructural constant-tail uncertainty remain unresolved.
No post-label changes, no probability floors, no extra resampling/refits or promotion.

paired_tail_method.reason: Confirmed supplied Gaussian z9..10 fixture: exponentiating large-side conditional log probabilities rounds all to1 despite varying, well-resolved complementary small probabilities. Requiring that numerically constant large coordinate to establish absolute MCSE needlessly rejects valid complementary information.
paired_tail_method.input: Jointly aligned per-component log-win and log-lose with validated complementary normalization and common forecast chain/draw/race axes.
paired_tail_method.coordinate: Choose pooled smaller side, retain its stable rescaled conditional probabilities and centered deviations. Equal-weight conditional mixture; never multiply by categorical row weights again.
paired_tail_method.larger_side: Use the exact negative centered smaller-side deviations for complement probability. Absolute MCSE is identical; larger-side relative MCSE uses its stable log mean, and source/forecast-chain differences use stable log1mexp of the small-side chain means.
paired_tail_method.stable_outputs: Retain finite log probability/log MCSE even when ordinary probabilities or MCSE underflow. Missing numeric display is not an exact zero-error certificate. Tests must exercise the below-machine-epsilon near-one case and tiny tails.
paired_tail_method.unsupported: If the informative smaller coordinate is nonstructurally constant, all−infinity or otherwise unresolved, do not manufacture qualification for the pair. Preserve original one-sided status alongside derived complementary evidence.
paired_tail_method.scope: Paired mathematical coordinate for the same probability functional, not a weakened convergence threshold or raw-all-win rule.

score_influences.Brier: Use the shared smaller-side centered deviation with the correct side sign; do not subtract two probabilities rounded to1.
score_influences.negative_log: Use the same stable centered deviations divided in log/scaled form by the applicable outcome probability; never evaluate1−exp(nearly0) by cancellation.
score_influences.PO5: Deterministic analytic Gaussian reference has no Monte Carlo quantile influence requirement. A truth exactly on a quantile is a valid WIS evaluation; no sampling derivative is needed. Deterministic quadrature error remains separate.
score_influences.F0: Retain original unsorted predictive replicates or their authenticated reference so row-clustered CRPS influences can be reconstructed; sorted pooled CDF/row means alone are insufficient.

interval_display.selected_method: Pointwise local frozen-CDF-MCSE mapping: evaluate MCSE at qhat, then invert pooled CDF at max(0,q−3MCSE) and min(1,q+3MCSE).
interval_display.qualification: Explicit first-order/local numerical diagnostic only. Not a variable-MCSE monotone envelope, conservative bound, simultaneous interval or calibration guarantee.
interval_display.effect: Display status only, distinct from primary score MCSE and retry. Unstable/failed numerical inversion remains unresolved.
interval_display.precedence: This explicit implementation choice supersedes the unselected variable-MCSE-envelope recommendation in the Sol design proposal.

fail_closed_gates: Every requested gate name must be present and explicitly true or an explicitly valid structural exemption. Missing/null/unresolved gate values are not successful by vacuous all(empty).
implementation_acceptance: Separate paired helper and runner/scoring changes require exact source pins and independent supplied-fixture review before execution. Existing sealed trace/math packets remain unchanged.
